<!--
Lemon is a menu-bar orchestrator: tag an issue 🍋 and it spins up a git worktree,
launches your own `claude` CLI, and drives it to a PR. This template works whether
you're filing for a human or handing the task to Lemon.

To let Lemon pick this up after filing:
  1. Assign the issue to yourself
  2. Add the 🍋 label
Lemon only acts on issues that are BOTH assigned to you AND labeled 🍋 by you
(the assignee + labeler trust gate). Leave both off for a normal human-tracked issue.

Best results come from scope, not length. One clear change beats a wishlist.
Delete the bug/feature section you don't need.
-->
